comments.content:
Now that oxygen tanks have little enough oxygen that they can conceivably
run out of oxygen, something that can hold like 3 items and half the oxygen
of a normal tank would actually be an interesting compromise rather than
strictly better than an oxygen tank. Having two spare hands is way more
effective and less infuriating than one.

I think a simple solution would be to lower Oxy tank capcity to about 20-30 minutes
worth on ALL tanks, and make them take up 3 slots in a backpack (if that's easy to
do). won't require a special item and adds more flexibility.

I don't think Capn Lurch's suggestion matches Kurper's request. He isn't asking to be
able to toss the tank into the backpack, but rather to make a backpack which can
store oxygen (in addition to items). I kind of like the current trade off...

i also like the current tradeoff, but maybe if you're looking for additional
storage... could we make a bag that fits on the belt slot and holds 3 items or
something? kind of like a tool pouch
i like the tool pouch idea
